es.title: Aliseda desembarca en Cangas y acepta los cambios del gobierno en el proyecto
es.description: Hasta cinco representantes del grupo Aliseda desembarcaron ayer en el Concello de Cangas para mantener un encuentro con el concejal de Urbanismo, Antón Iglesias (BNG) , y técnicos municipales. Por fin este grupo empresarial que se ocupa del proyecto del Plan Especial de Reforma Interior (PERI) de Altamira, dentro de la Unidad de Actuación Número 5 de Cangas, está en disposición de aceptar todas las condiciones puestas desde el Concello de Cangas y asegurar que dentro de 15 días entrará por el registro municipal el proyecto definitivo. El gobierno local tiene la intención de presentarlo a la oposición (fue un asunto que se siguió siempre muy de cerca por la junta de portavoces) para que después vaya al pleno para su aprobación inicial. Hay que tener en cuenta que el proyecto de Aliseda ya fue sometido al estudio de impacto medioambiental.

es.title: La «saturación» de los astilleros gallegos impide ofertar la entrega de nuevos buques para antes de 2030
es.description: Con cerca de 200 astilleros operativos y (casi) todas las facilidades posibles en materia de financiación, el naval de China suma a día de hoy el equivalente a más de cuatro años de carga de trabajo, de acuerdo al analista jefe de transporte marítimo de BIMCO, Niels Rasmussen, en un estudio divulgado esta semana. Es decir, sus industrias tendrían trabajos pendientes de completar hasta casi plantarse en el año 2031 sin necesidad de poner nuevos encargos en vigor. Un elevadísimo volumen de actividad que ilustran las siguientes cifras: para 2028, por ejemplo, los astilleros chinos tienen programadas entregas por 44 millones de CGT (siglas de arqueo bruto compensado o compensated gross tonnage), frente a los 22,7 millones de CGT completados el año pasado. «Deben aumentar la producción anual a nuevos máximos históricos para poder cumplir con la demanda», expone Rasmussen.

es.title: «El covid sigue ahí y a veces tenemos hasta 40 ingresos; hay que vacunarse»
es.description: Con la campaña de vacunación de la gripe ya en marcha, existe la sensación generalizada de que hemos perdido el miedo al covid. Sin embargo, los datos no engañan. Pese a la tendencia a la baja en toda Galicia, el área sanitaria de Ourense ha registrado un leve incremento en la incidencia, situándose en 30,1 consultas y 7,7 ingresos por cada 100.000 habitantes. La doctora María Sande, jefa de Medicina Preventiva del Complejo Hospitalario Universitario de Ourense (CHOU) advierte que el covid «sigue estando ahí, con picos de hasta 40 o 50 ingresos hospitalarios en ocasiones; los perfiles de riesgo deben vacunarse, al igual que con la gripe».

es.title: Doce años sin «ITV» en regla y otros cuatro con caída de cascotes: el CSIC inicia al fin la reforma integral del IEO vigués
es.description: El Centro Oceanográfico de Vigo es, en palabras de su director, Pablo Otero, un «referente nacional e internacional en investigación marina, asesoramiento científico‐técnico y transferencia de conocimiento». Lleva décadas demostrándolo con todo tipo de hitos científicos: el complejo de Cabo Estai fue pionero en la transferencia de tecnología en cultivo de rodaballos, desarrolló el protocolo de mantenimiento y maduración en cautividad de la cherna o, solo durante el año pasado, su personal completó 10.255 jornadas a bordo por campañas de investigación oceanográfica. Cuestión distinta es la infraestructura en la que la plantilla —son 197 personas— ha tenido que desempeñar su trabajo, unos edificios en muy mal estado de conservación debido a la corrosión del mar y la falta de mantenimiento. Ahora, tras 12 años con la Inspección Técnica de Edificios (ITE) caducada y con el personal de la nave de cultivos obligada a llevar casco por caída de cascotes —como desveló FARO en febrero de 2023—, arrancan al fin las obras para su remodelación total.

es.title: La deuda global se encamina a su índice más alto desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial
es.description: El mundo está cada vez más endeudado y, con el paso del tiempo, cada vez va a ser más difícil financiar esa deuda. gr.title: Πότε αλλάζει η ώρα
gr.description: Η αλλαγή της ώρας πραγματοποιείται κάθε χρόνο την τελευταία Κυριακή του Οκτωβρίου – και η αλλαγή στη θερινή την τελευταία Κυριακή του Μαρτίου. Την Κυριακή 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026 αλλάζει η ώρα και οι δείκτες των ρολογιών θα πρέπει να μετακινηθούν μία ώρα πίσω, δηλαδή από 04.:00 π.μ. σε 03.00 π.μ. Σε ανακοίνωσή του, το υπουργείο Υποδομών και Μεταφορών αναφέρει: «Την Κυριακή 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, λήγει η εφαρμογή του μέτρου της θερινής ώρας, σύμφωνα με την οδηγία 2000/84/ΕΚ του Ευρωπαϊκού Κοινοβουλίου και του Συμβουλίου της Ε.Ε. της 19ης Ιανουαρίου 2001, σχετικά με τις διατάξεις για τη θερινή ώρα. Ως εκ τούτου, τα ξημερώματα της Κυριακής, οι δείκτες των ρολογιών θα πρέπει να μετακινηθούν μία ώρα πίσω, δηλαδή από 04.00 π.μ. σε 03.00 π.μ.». Η αλλαγή της ώρας πραγματοποιείται κάθε χρόνο την τελευταία Κυριακή του Οκτωβρίου – και η αλλαγή στη θερινή την τελευταία Κυριακή του Μαρτίου. Φέτος, η μετάβαση γίνεται στις 25 Οκτωβρίου και αυτή είναι η νωρίτερη ημερομηνία που μπορεί να γίνει η αλλαγή. Νωρίτερα η αλλαγή της ώρας φέτος λόγω της τελευταίας Κυριακής του μήνα Το 2026, ωστόσο, η τελευταία Κυριακή πέφτει στις 25 του μήνα, μία ημερομηνία που είναι λίγο πιο νωρίς από ό,τι συνήθως. Η ρύθμιση γίνεται πάντα ξημερώματα Κυριακής ώστε να ελαχιστοποιηθούν τα προβλήματα στις μετακινήσεις και την καθημερινότητα. Όσον αφορά τις αυτόματες συσκευές, δηλαδή τα κινητά τηλέφωνα, οι υπολογιστές και οι «smart» συσκευές ενημερώνονται συνήθως αυτόματα. Δεν πρέπει να ξεχάσετε να ρυθμίσετε χειροκίνητα τα αναλογικά ρολόγια, τα μη αυτόματα ξυπνητήρια και τα ρολόγια αυτοκινήτων. Το ζήτημα της κατάργησης της αλλαγής της ώρας Η συζήτηση για την κατάργηση της εποχικής αλλαγής της ώρας στην Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση παραμένει ανοιχτή εδώ και χρόνια, καθώς το 2018, η Ευρωπαϊκή Επιτροπή είχε καταθέσει πρόταση για τον τερματισμό της πρακτικής της μετακίνησης των δεικτών δύο φορές τον χρόνο. Το Ευρωπαϊκό Κοινοβούλιο είχε ταχθεί υπέρ της αλλαγής του ισχύοντος συστήματος. Μέχρι σήμερα δεν έχει ληφθεί η απαιτούμενη τελική απόφαση, με αποτέλεσμα να εξακολουθεί να εφαρμόζεται το υφιστάμενο καθεστώς. #ΑΛΛΑΓΗ_ΩΡΑΣ #ΑΛΛΑΓΗ_ΩΡΑΣ_2026

ro.title: Un semnal radio misterios, detectat în Calea Lactee, îi intrigă pe astronomi. Ce ar putea ascunde fenomenul fără precedent
ro.description: Astronomii încearcă să descifreze misterul unui obiect cosmic aflat la cel puțin 49.000 de ani-lumină de Pământ, la periferia Căii Lactee, care emite unde radio într-un mod neobișnuit. Sursa, denumită VT J1906+0849, prezintă variații spectaculoase ale intensității emisiei de aproximativ două decenii, iar comportamentul său nu seamănă cu cel al altor obiecte cunoscute din galaxie. Cercetătorii iau în calcul mai multe explicații, inclusiv existența unei găuri negre sau a unei stele neutronice care atrage materie de la o stea însoțitoare, relatează Science Alert.

mx.title: ¿Para qué sirve el botón “Shift Lock Release” de la transmisión automática de tu carro y cuándo debes usarlo?
mx.description: En un coche equipado con una transmisión manual las cosas suelen ser más sencillas en algunos aspectos, como poder echarlos a andar con un empujón en segunda velocidad y liberar el pedal del embrague, para que la propia inercia de las ruedas transfiera movimiento al motor para que encienda. En resumen, si necesitas mover el coche porque el motor no enciende, simplemente debes pisar el embrague, mover la palanca a posición de neutral y el coche quedará libre de las ruedas, algo que no sucede en un auto equipado con una transmisión automática. Cuando desplazas la palanca hasta la posición de Park también se activa un gancho mecánico que actúa como un seguro de estacionamiento, por lo que, si el coche por alguna razón no enciende, será más difícil liberarlo en comparación con el coche manual, aunque no imposible, pues para ello existe un dispositivo diseñado para cumplir con el cometido el Shift Lock Release. Este mecanismo, que puede aparecer en forma de botón, sirve para desbloquear manualmente la palanca de cambios de una transmisión automática y moverla de la posición P, de estacionamiento, a la N de neutral cuando el auto está apagado, se quedó sin batería o presenta una falla en el sistema eléctrico. Ten presente que, cuando el batería o acumulador ya no tiene carga, lo que provoca que el coche no encienda, la palanca se queda trabada en P, porque el sistema eléctrico no detecta que estamos pisando el freno para liberar el seguro. Entonces el Shift Lock Relase permite colocar la transmisión en N para poder empujar el vehículo o subirlo con facilidad a una grúa de plataforma. Para utilizarlo, lo primero que debemos hacer es asegurarnos de que el freno de mano esté bien puesto. Posteriormente debemos localizar una pequeña tapa plástica cerca de la base de la palanca de la transmisión o, en algunos modelos, ubicar un botón visible que se identifica fácilmente. En el caso de que el botón no esté visible, y ya que ubicamos una pequeña tapa de plástico cerca de la palanca de la transmisión, debemos retirarla con cuidado usando un desarmador plano o algo que sirva de cuña. Una vez hecho eso debes presionar el botón o inserta la llave o algún objeto delgado en el orificio para accionar el seguro interno, al mismo tiempo que debe pisarse el pedal del freno y mover la palanca hacia la posición N. Como lo hemos dicho en otras ocasiones, lo ideal es que antes de enfrentar un escenario como este, debes consultar el manual de propietario de tu coche, donde te explica la ubicación exacta de este mecanismo, ya sea jun botón o este oculto bajo una tapa, así como los pasos precisos para liberar la transmisión automática y poder mover el coche. Foto de portada: Nano Banana 2. - La noticia ¿Para qué sirve el botón “Shift Lock Release” de la transmisión automática de tu carro y cuándo debes usarlo? fue publicada originalmente en Motorpasión México por Pablo Monroy .

ph.title: Catching up with Wilbert Ross: A hit movie, a homecoming concert, and a well-deserved break
ph.description: Wilbert Ross is having quite a year. His first film with Bea Binene, “Pee Mak,” raked in P40 million at the local box office in its first week, adding another milestone to a career that has also seen a string of sold-out concerts. In a recent interview, Ross spoke about the film’s success, the fans who helped make it happen, and what he hopes to do once he finally gets some time for himself. “Very proud of myself talaga, for all the hard work, and very thankful for the support of Viva kasi ever since sila naman talaga ang nagtiwala at sumuporta sa akin so, sa lahat ng ito, concerts, digital series, tapos ito nga, movie and all, sila talaga, so very grateful,” he said. Ross also made sure to acknowledge the fans, particularly the WilBea supporters who have followed his partnership with Binene through several projects. “Of course, I feel dun talaga nagsimula rin yun. Yung partnership namin ni Bea from ‘Golden Scenery of Tomorrow’ to ‘Love U Lots,’ e, nanganak nang nanganak yun hanggang ito na nga, dumating itong opportunity na ito. So, I'm very grateful sa mga supporters namin talaga,” he said. Still, the success of “Pee Mak” came as a pleasant surprise. “We did our best in terms of what we can give the film, acting-wise, pero hindi ko talaga in-expect na ganito tatanggapin ng mga tao yung film. I think, maganda rin lang kasi yung materyal, at pinagbutihan rin namin ang ginawa namin so, ganun na lang din ang pagtangkilik ng mga tao sa pelikula. Kumbaga, sila ang nagpatunay,” he said. Word of mouth, he added, helped the film find its audience, especially since the cast had limited time for promotion amid their other commitments. “Oo kasi feeling ko hirap din kami sa promo sa sobrang busy namin, pero yun nga, yung mga tao na rin lang ang nagpakalat at nag-promote ng film for us,” Ross said. He hopes the film’s momentum carries on in the coming weeks. For now, Ross has another date to prepare for: his homecoming concert in Davao on Oct. 25. Despite his packed schedule, he is determined to give the audience a performance worth waiting for. “Sigurado ako na hindi ko sila bibigyan ng hilaw na performance. Like right now, tuloy-tuloy pa rin ang rehearsals namin, iniingatan ko rin yung boses at health ko, ganun,” he said. He is currently dealing with a sore throat but is doing his best to recover in time for the show. After all that, Ross is looking forward to something a little less demanding: a long break. He plans to visit relatives in Australia and take time to unwind. “I'm going to visit relatives there and I want to relax for a bit muna. I think deserve ko din naman,” he said. But don't mistake the desire to rest for a waning passion for his work. Asked if he was experiencing burnout, Ross said he still wanted to do more. When the going gets tough, he reminds himself of what he once dreamed of and the hardships he endured to get here. “Every time I feel that, yung tinatawag na burnout, sinasabi ko sa sarili ko na, ‘Di ba ito ang gusto mo? Di ba ito ang pinaghirapan mo nang matagal? Di ba ito ang dahilan kung bakit mo nilunok lahat ng pangmamaliit na narinig mo noon?’ Yun yung nagpu-push sa akin na magpatuloy.” “As long as kaya ko pang bumangon, kumanta, magsulat, gagawin ko.”

ph.title: BFP contingent bags top plum in int'l rescue event competition in China
ph.description: The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) delegation clinched the top spot in the “Advanced Denver Rescue Event’’ competition at the 2nd International Fireground Survival Championship held in Fujian province, China. BFP delegation head Chief Supt. Fred Trajeras Jr. said the winning Philippine team is composed of its coach Supt. Orlando Antonio, Senior Fire Officer 3 Joeffrey Valdez, Senior Fire Officer 2 Raymart de Guzman, Fire Officer 1 Keith Louie Gonzales, Fire Officer 2 John Henry Oducado and Fire Officer 1 Rey Mark Llegado. With the BFP team bringing honor to the country, Trajeras expressed pride for the outstanding performance, dedication and teamwork shown by the team. For his part, BFP officer-in-charge (OIC) Chief Supt. Wilberto Rico Neil Kwan Tiu commended his men for their remarkable achievement in the international tournament. Likewise, Kwan Tiu hailed the members of the winning team for their dedication, professionalism and commitment to excellence, reflecting the BFP’s continuing efforts to strengthen the capabilities of Filipino firefighters in rescue operations and other emergency response missions. “This victory is a testament to the hard work, discipline, and collective commitment of our firefighters to continuous learning, operational excellence, and the protection of lives and communities. Held from October 19 to 25, the 2nd International Fireground Survival Championship is an international competition focused on firefighter survival, Mayday response, firefighter rescue, and operational teamwork. The competition brings together fire and rescue teams, instructors, referees, and observers from China and other countries, emphasizing practical firefighter survival skills, teamwork, communication, Mayday procedures, and the rescue of a downed firefighter. Aside from the competition, the firefighter skills tournament is also a platform for international exchange, operational learning, and the development of safer fireground practices.

ph.title: SM Hotels showcases Halloween celebrations across its brand portfolio
ph.description: Halloween takes many forms, from children’s costume parties and playful discoveries to themed dining and live music. This October, nine properties of SM Hotels and Conventions Corp. (SMHCC) are marking the season with celebrations designed for different ages and interests, giving families and friends more ways to spend time together beyond the traditional trick-or-treat routine. ph.title: The French have launched a prize for AI-written books
ph.description: They say AI is a tool for people to use. Once, when AI was marketed as a tool for writing, I had assumed it would: Check grammar and check if you’ve unconsciously written a similar paragraph from a well-established author. I imagine it could pull up resources that you ask for and point at sites you can further conduct your research. I imagined it could help people with disabilities write, for instance, dictate speech to text with greater accuracy. But no. People have ideas. Everyone gets an idea. I believe every idea is brilliant, and there is no such thing as a bad idea unless it is something that somehow negatively affects another human being. But what makes the idea look good is how well it is executed. Any writer out there who is working on their written art would understand the pains of staring at a blank screen for hours. It could go on for days or weeks, maybe even months, before an actual sentence is typed out, and that’s fine. Art is a creative process. It gestates and finds nourishment in lives that are experienced in one way or the other. For a lot of writers, writing is a joy. It is something filled with pain, exploration, and discoverability. The process of writing itself, developing stories, building characters, exploring situations. That’s all the fun part, even if it takes years. It’s the long and arduous process that gives a piece of art its soul. Quoting something from the film, Saturday Night, the fictional version of Lorne Michaels said: “Art is but a measurement of sacrifice, and tears.” I scrolled up to check the placeholder headline I'd typed in and realized I'd wandered far too away from what I should have been writing about. In any case, in France, earlier this week was the launch of the Prix Pascal de Littérature – no relation to Pedro, I know he’s everywhere, but not this time – it’s an entry for books written with the help of AI. It doesn’t state how much AI can be used, and it doesn’t seem there are any real limits, since part of the entry is what prompt and which LLM was used. The only thing that matters in this entry is that the generated output must be in the French language. It must also be between 10,000 and 50,000 words. While entries must be generated as an output of fiction, its theme should try to solve problems, ethical, social, any threat to humanity, basically. After reading that criteria, and, if I may, perhaps the purpose of this program is not to simply award the best prompter, but an attempt to train AI certain things are a threat and humans would want AI to help in preservation. But that’s me reaching.

ph.title: Brewers stave off Rays’ rally, draw first blood in World Series
ph.description: MILWAUKEE (AP) — Trevor Megill struck out Jonny DeLuca with runners on second and third to wiggle out of a ninth-inning jam as the Milwaukee Brewers escaped with a 3-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 1 of the World Series on Friday night, Oct. 23. DeLuca's strikeout came after Tampa Bay's Liam Hicks had grounded into an apparent game-ending double play that was overturned after a video review. Replays determined that Brewers shortstop Cooper Pratt's right foot was slightly off the bag when he reached to catch a high throw from second baseman Brice Turang. Jacob Misiorowski allowed one run over five innings to earn the win. Christian Yelich hit an RBI triple to spark a two-run rally in the first inning that put the Brewers ahead for good and delighted a sellout crowd reveling in Milwaukee’s first World Series game since 1982. Jackson Chourio and William Contreras provided two hits each, and Contreras also threw out two potential base stealers. This marks the first World Series featuring two potential first-time champions since 1980, when the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Kansas City Royals in six games. The only other major league teams without a World Series title are the Colorado Rockies, San Diego Padres and Seattle Mariners. The Game 1 winner has gone on to win the World Series 62.8% of the time. Tampa Bay trailed 3-1 and hadn't put a runner on since the sixth inning until it mounted its comeback try in the ninth. Jonathan Aranda and Chandler Simpson hit consecutive one-out singles off Megill. A double steal involving pinch-runner Jorge Mateo and Simpson put the potential tying run in scoring position with Rays slugger Junior Caminero at the plate. Caminero walked on a 3-2 pitch in the dirt to load the bases. Hicks hit a grounder to the right side, and Turang ranged well to his left to field the ball before throwing to Pratt to start what initially was ruled a game-ending double play. But a replay review determined Pratt’s right foot came off the bag as he caught Turang’s throw. Hicks was still out at first, but the Rays now had runners at second and third with the score 3-2. Megill finally closed the deal as DeLuca struck out swinging. By sweeping the two-time defending World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series, the Brewers had time to set up their rotation the way they wanted by handing the Game 1 start to Misiorowski, the hard-throwing NL Cy Young Award favorite. Misiorowski opened the game by throwing the fastest pitch ever delivered in a World Series game, a 103.5 mph ball to Yandy Díaz. The right-hander ended up allowing only one run over five innings with a season-low three strikeouts. While Milwaukee opened with its ace, Tampa Bay countered with Nick Martinez to give two-time All-Star pitchers Drew Rasmussen and Freddy Peralta an extra day of rest. Martinez struck out five and allowed two runs over five innings, but a slow start proved costly. Chourio lined a single to right on Martinez’s first pitch, and Yelich drove him home with a one-out triple to center. DeLuca covered 85 feet to track Yelich’s drive down but just missed making a diving catch. Yelich was batting third in the lineup for the first time since Aug. 3. The three-time All-Star and 2018 NL MVP posted the lowest on-base percentage (.315) and OPS (.692) of his career, but he has stepped up his since being named the first team captain in franchise history the final week of the regular season. He was the seventh player to triple in his first World Series plate appearance, and the first since Kansas City’s Lynn Jones in 1985, according to the Elias Sports Bureau. Contreras knocked home Yelich with a single to left that was deflected by shortstop Taylor Walls. Tampa Bay got a run back in the fourth. Aranda drew a leadoff walk and advanced to third when Caminero doubled on a liner with a 112.7 mph exit velocity that sailed over the head of center fielder Garrett Mitchell. Aranda came home on a grounder to the right side. Milwaukee extended the lead to 3-1 in the seventh. Pratt drew a leadoff walk from Steven Matz and scored from second when Chourio greeted Kevin Kelly with a two-out single to right. That insurance run proved critical.

ph.title: Typhoon Champi kills 1 and injures 350 in Taiwan overnight as storm weakens
ph.description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — Typhoon Champi killed one person and injured hundreds in Taiwan, as well as downing trees and knocking out power for hundreds of thousands of people as the storm's strong winds and rains continued overnight Friday into Saturday morning. Although Champi did not hit Taiwan directly, the storm's span was large enough to impact most of Taiwan. The island's weather authorities said the storm was weakening Saturday morning and that by evening, the land warnings for the typhoon would be removed. Taiwan's Central Emergency Operations Center reported that 350 were injured as of Friday night. The one death was a man who was washed away by waves in Taiwan's Pingtung county, the island's southernmost part. The storm knocked out power for 280,000 households, according to United Daily News, a local Taiwanese newspaper, citing the island's power authorities. But power had returned to 80% of households by Saturday morning. On Friday, 563 flights were canceled at Taiwan's main international airport in Taoyuan. An additional 261 flights were canceled on Saturday, according to the semi-official Central News Agency. Across the island, the storm downed trees and signs, some smaller structures, and even the ceiling of a college dorm in Taipei. It will weaken as it head toward Japan.

bd.description: CHENGDU, China, Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- At the 19th EU-China Business Meeting, co-hosted by the China Chamber of International Commerce (CCOIC) and the European Union Chamber of Commerce in China (EUCCC) in Chengdu, LivingPHOENIX Regenerative Technology Development (Chengdu) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "LivingPHOENIX"), a tenant enterprise of Tianfu International Bio City, achieved a significant milestone. Dr. Qin Xingjiong, the company's founder, led his industrialization team to attend the event and witnessed the Global Launch Preview Ceremony of the company's core product: POGMENT® Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen-Based Extracellular Matrix (ECM) Medical Devices. This launch not only marks China's technological leap from "catching up" to "leading" in the field of high-end regenerative medicine materials but also demonstrates the strength of intelligent manufacturing in China to the international market. Dr. Qin Xingjiong, Founder of LivingPHOENIX Regenerative Technology, Discusses the “Global Debut” of Third-Generation Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen Medical Devices in an Exclusive Interview On-Site Highlights: European Buyers Show Strong Interest, and Experience Builds Trust As one of the focal points of this year's meeting, LivingPHOENIX's booth attracted heavy foot traffic. Statistics show that the booth received 55 potential clients from European countries, with 29 classified as high-intent prospects. "European customers' trust in Chinese innovative technology exceeded our expectations," said Dr. Qin. "At the venue, numerous international guests from Switzerland, Spain, France, and other regions personally experienced SMARTENDER® Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen series products. Unlike traditional skincare products that remain on the skin's surface for hydration, these functional skincare products, based on 'Third-Generation Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen ECM' technology, impressed attendees with their exceptional transdermal absorption capabilities. Multiple foreign guests reported that the products not only offered excellent skin feel but also solved the industry pain point of 'dehydration that cannot be replenished'—'Moisture doesn't vanish instantly; it is truly absorbed by the skin.' Pablo, Executive Director of the China-Spain Chamber of Commerce, gave high praise after trying the product: 'I tried your face mask yesterday and I love how my skin felt.' This authentic feedback validates the strong capabilities of POGMENT® Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen materials in anti-wrinkle and deep moisturizing applications." As night fell, a distinctive "Hotpot Dinner" became a memorable part of the meeting. Dr. Liu Zhanyan, Executive Director of the Euro-Chinese Business Association, sat around the hotpot with Swiss medical device and beauty innovation entrepreneurs. Amidst the bubbling red oil and candid exchanges, they broke down the final barriers to cross-border cooperation, transforming daytime technical admiration into nighttime consensus for collaboration. Notably, European guests such as Richard and Jolanda were invited to participate in the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the "Global Launch Preview of Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen-Based ECM Medical Devices." This interactive session symbolizes the deep connection between China and Europe in biotechnology and indicates that LivingPHOENIX's products possess the quality confidence to compete head-to-head with top-tier international brands. Strategic Thinking: Beyond Trade, Becoming a "Born Global" Technology Platform Exporter Addressing the heated topic of "Going Global," Dr. Qin proposed a unique perspective: "Many treat going global as a business transaction, but LivingPHOENIX treats it as a strategy. We aim to build a 'born-global' enterprise." He believes that the European market is not only a center of technological innovation and demand barometer for global biomedicine but also sets industry entry standards through its regulatory science system. Its immense international influence means: "Entering Europe is equivalent to obtaining a passport to the global market." "If we can capture the European market, it means our technology, quality, and compliance systems have withstood rigorous tests, which will significantly lower the threshold for entering markets in the US, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia." Dr. Qin emphasized that what LivingPHOENIX seeks is not simple commodity trade, but "comprehensive, in-depth cooperation" based on a complete, independently owned core technology platform. This cooperative model covers multiple dimensions, including trade, compliance certification, ODM joint manufacturing, product development, application scenario expansion, and even secondary technology development. Previously, the LivingPHOENIX team had completed multiple rounds of technical exchanges in France and the UK. This meeting further enabled the company to leap from being "selected by customers" to having the freedom to "select customers." Technical Decoding: Overcoming the "121°C Sterilization" Industry Bottleneck, Defining Third-Generation Collagen Standards Underpinning LivingPHOENIX's confidence in global expansion is its world-first core technology: Triple-Helix Biomimetic Collagen-Based ECM. For years, traditional animal-derived collagen has suffered from high immunogenicity, viral transmission risks, and poor stability. While second-generation recombinant collagen addressed safety issues, its lack of natural triple-helix structure limited biological functions. LivingPHOENIX obtains amino acids through green biomanufacturing, uses aqueous-phase chemical condensation to precisely construct homologous triple-helix skeletons, and forms highly stable Extracellular Matrix (ECM) networks through engineered assembly. "We have truly achieved fine-tuned control where 'structure determines function,'" noted Dr. Qin. This technology endows the material with excellent thermal stability, successfully overcoming the common industry challenge of tolerating 121°C terminal sterilization for finished medical devices, while simultaneously doubling mechanical strength and biological functionality. Currently, LivingPHOENIX has built a tiered product matrix covering Class II medical devices, cosmetics, Class III aesthetic medical devices, and implantable Class III devices. The Global Launch Preview includes eight Class II medical device dressing products, such as sterile patches, liquid dressings, repair dressings, scar gels, and gynecological gels. This matrix precisely benchmarks against the "Medical Device–Cosmetics Integration" high-end product systems of leading international cosmetics giants in terms of dosage form richness and application scenarios. Approval from the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) is expected between November and December 2026. The first product has completed the system assessment, requests for supplementary information and subsequent correction processes, soon filling the domestic market gap for high-end biomimetic collagen dressings. Leveraging the stable triple-helix structural design, POGMENT® acts as a "Collagen Engine," achieving multi-fold leaps in fibroblast collagen deposition (Class III devices) and epithelial cell repair efficacy, and constructing a full dosage form technology matrix including solutions, freeze-dried fibers, self-crosslinking gels, and composite gels. To date, two core invention patents (involving triple-helix biomimetic collagen self-crosslinking hydrogels and ECM regenerative materials) have passed preliminary examination in Chengdu and entered the substantive review stage at the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA), building a solid technological moat. On the commercial front, SMARTENDER®, the world's first functional skincare brand based on this technology, was officially launched in November 2025. Validated by data from 25,000 real-user tests and high influencer repurchase rates, the product line fully confirms the feasibility of its business model in terms of safety, efficacy, and user retention. Looking ahead, this underlying technology is accelerating its extension into high-value medical consumables such as cartilage repair scaffolds, bone repair materials, and cardiovascular patches, aiming to become the core force defining the future of regenerative medicine. Corporate Confidence: Patent Moats and Dual Barriers of "Source Innovation + National Recognition" As a source-innovation enterprise in the regenerative medicine field, located in Tianfu International Bio City, Chengdu, LivingPHOENIX has established solid intellectual property and compliance barriers. To date, the company has filed 14 invention patents (including 8 Chinese invention patents and 6 PCT international patents). bd.title: Lunit and Summit Therapeutics Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development
bd.description: Research Will Use Lunit's AI-powered Pathology Platform to Analyze H&E Whole-Slide Images and Generate Scalable Insights into Tumor Microenvironment Biology SEOUL, South Korea, Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lunit Inc. (KRX: 328130) and Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced a research agreement to evaluate the use of Lunit SCOPE IO, Lunit's AI-powered pathology platform, for tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit's immuno-oncology development programs with ivonescimab. Lunit and Summit Therapeutics The effort will focus on applying Lunit SCOPE IO to hematoxylin and eosin-stained (H&E) whole-slide images to characterize tumor microenvironment features. The companies aim to explore how AI-powered pathology analysis can support biomarker discovery, patient stratification or selection, and a deeper biological understanding of response to ivonescimab therapies. Summit is developing ivonescimab, a novel, potential first-in-class investigational PD-1 / VEGF bispecific antibody, in several solid tumors. Lunit SCOPE IO is designed to support immuno-oncology research and biomarker development through AI-powered analysis of H&E slides, enabling scalable assessment of tumor microenvironment features without requiring additional stains or assays. "Understanding the tumor microenvironment is increasingly important as immuno-oncology moves beyond single-axis checkpoint inhibition toward more complex mechanisms and combinations," said Allen Yang, MD, PhD, Chief Research and Development Strategy Officer of Summit. "We are pleased to work with Lunit to explore how AI-powered pathology can help generate deeper, more scalable insights from routine tissue samples and inform the continued development of ivonescimab." "Summit is at the forefront of next-generation immuno-oncology development, and we are excited to support its efforts with Lunit SCOPE IO," said Brandon Suh, Lunit CEO. "By extracting quantitative, spatially resolved immune and tumor microenvironment features from standard H&E slides, we believe SCOPE IO can help biopharma partners better understand which patients may benefit from immuno-oncology therapies and why." This agreement reflects the growing importance of computational pathology in oncology drug development. Routine H&E slides contain rich information about tumor architecture, immune infiltration, stromal organization, and spatial interactions within the tumor microenvironment. However, traditional manual assessment can be difficult to scale and may not fully capture the quantitative and spatial complexity of the tumor-immune interface. AI-powered analysis offers the potential to convert these routinely generated pathology images into reproducible, high-dimensional biomarker data. The companies expect the work to generate tumor microenvironment insights that may inform future translational research, exploratory biomarker strategies, and clinical development planning. No clinical outcome data are being announced as part of this release. *Lunit SCOPE products are for research use only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures or decisions. About Ivonescimab Ivonescimab, known as SMT112 in Summit's license territories, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Japan, and as AK112 outside of Summit's license territories, is a novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule. By design, ivonescimab displays unique cooperative binding to each of its intended targets with multifold higher affinity to PD-1 when in the presence of VEGF. This design is intended to differentiate ivonescimab as there is potentially higher expression (presence) of both PD-1 and VEGF in tumor tissue and the tumor microenvironment (TME) as compared to normal tissue in the body. Summit believes ivonescimab's specifically engineered tetravalent structure (four binding sites) enables higher avidity (accumulated strength of multiple binding interactions) in the TME (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025). This tetravalent structure, the intentional novel design of the molecule, and bringing these two targets into a single bispecific antibody with cooperative binding qualities have the potential to direct ivonescimab to the tumor tissue versus healthy tissue. The intent of ivonescimab's design, together with a half-life of 6 to 7 days after the first dose (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025) increasing to approximately 10 days at steady state dosing, is to improve upon previously established efficacy thresholds, side effects, and safety profiles associated with prior approved drugs to these targets. Ivonescimab was invented by Akeso Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK) and is currently utilized in multiple Phase III clinical trials. Over 5,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab in clinical studies globally and over 100,000 patients when considering those treated in a commercial setting in China, as noted by Akeso. There are currently 17 Phase III clinical studies that are either announced, ongoing, or have been completed studying ivonescimab, five of which are Summit-sponsored global studies, two of which are studies sponsored by cooperative groups, and 10 of which are being or have been conducted in China by Akeso. Summit began its clinical development of ivonescimab in NSCLC (HARMONi, HARMONi-3, HARMONi-7) and expanded its sponsored Phase III clinical development program into colorectal cancer (CRC; HARMONi-GI3) and urothelial carcinoma (bladder cancer; HARMONi-GU1). The two cooperative studies are in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC; ILLUMINE) and biliary tract cancer (BTC; EA2251). Five Phase III ivonescimab clinical trials have read out to date, all five with positive data. Four of these five studies are in NSCLC and one is in BTC. In addition to Summit's positive HARMONi study in NSCLC, Akeso has had positive read-outs in four single-region (China), randomized Phase III clinical trials, HARMONi-A, HARMONi-2, HARMONi-6 (each in NSCLC), and HARMONi-GI1 (in BTC) for ivonescimab, including a statistically significant overall survival benefit in all four studies from China. Akeso is actively conducting additional Phase III clinical studies in settings outside of NSCLC and biliary-tract cancer, including triple-negative breast cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic cancer. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy that is not approved by any regulatory authority in Summit's license territories, including the United States and Europe. Ivonescimab was initially approved for marketing authorization in China in May 2024. About Lunit Founded in 2013, Lunit (KRX: 328130) is a global leader on a mission to conquer cancer through AI. Our clinically validated solutions span medical imaging, breast health, and biomarker analysis, empowering earlier detection, smarter treatment decisions, and more precise outcomes across the cancer care continuum. Lunit offers a comprehensive suite spanning risk prediction and early detection to precision oncology. Our FDA-cleared Lunit INSIGHT Breast Suite and breast health solutions support cancer screening in thousands of medical institutions worldwide, while the Lunit SCOPE platform is used in research partnership with global pharma and laboratory leaders for biomarker research, and companion diagnostic development. Trusted by over 10,000 sites in more than 65 countries, Lunit combines deep medical expertise with continuously evolving datasets to deliver measurable impact for patients, clinicians, and researchers alike. Headquartered in Seoul with global offices, Lunit is driving the worldwide fight against cancer. Learn more at lunit.io. About Summit Therapeutics Inc. Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver- and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs. Summit was founded in 2003 and the company's shares are listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (symbol "SMMT"). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, with additional offices in Palo Alto, California, Princeton, New Jersey, Dublin, Ireland, and Oxford, UK. ae.title: Lunit and Summit Therapeutics Announce Agreement to Apply AI-powered SCOPE IO Platform for Tumor Microenvironment Analysis in Immuno-Oncology Development
ae.description: Research Will Use Lunit's AI-powered Pathology Platform to Analyze H&E Whole-Slide Images and Generate Scalable Insights into Tumor Microenvironment Biology SEOUL, South Korea, Oct. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lunit Inc. (KRX: 328130) and Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: SMMT) today announced a research agreement to evaluate the use of Lunit SCOPE IO, Lunit's AI-powered pathology platform, for tumor microenvironment analysis in support of Summit's immuno-oncology development programs with ivonescimab. Lunit and Summit Therapeutics The effort will focus on applying Lunit SCOPE IO to hematoxylin and eosin-stained (H&E) whole-slide images to characterize tumor microenvironment features. The companies aim to explore how AI-powered pathology analysis can support biomarker discovery, patient stratification or selection, and a deeper biological understanding of response to ivonescimab therapies. Summit is developing ivonescimab, a novel, potential first-in-class investigational PD-1 / VEGF bispecific antibody, in several solid tumors. Lunit SCOPE IO is designed to support immuno-oncology research and biomarker development through AI-powered analysis of H&E slides, enabling scalable assessment of tumor microenvironment features without requiring additional stains or assays. "Understanding the tumor microenvironment is increasingly important as immuno-oncology moves beyond single-axis checkpoint inhibition toward more complex mechanisms and combinations," said Allen Yang, MD, PhD, Chief Research and Development Strategy Officer of Summit. "We are pleased to work with Lunit to explore how AI-powered pathology can help generate deeper, more scalable insights from routine tissue samples and inform the continued development of ivonescimab." "Summit is at the forefront of next-generation immuno-oncology development, and we are excited to support its efforts with Lunit SCOPE IO," said Brandon Suh, Lunit CEO. "By extracting quantitative, spatially resolved immune and tumor microenvironment features from standard H&E slides, we believe SCOPE IO can help biopharma partners better understand which patients may benefit from immuno-oncology therapies and why." This agreement reflects the growing importance of computational pathology in oncology drug development. Routine H&E slides contain rich information about tumor architecture, immune infiltration, stromal organization, and spatial interactions within the tumor microenvironment. However, traditional manual assessment can be difficult to scale and may not fully capture the quantitative and spatial complexity of the tumor-immune interface. AI-powered analysis offers the potential to convert these routinely generated pathology images into reproducible, high-dimensional biomarker data. The companies expect the work to generate tumor microenvironment insights that may inform future translational research, exploratory biomarker strategies, and clinical development planning. No clinical outcome data are being announced as part of this release. *Lunit SCOPE products are for research use only. Not for use in diagnostic procedures or decisions. About Ivonescimab Ivonescimab, known as SMT112 in Summit's license territories, North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Japan, and as AK112 outside of Summit's license territories, is a novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody combining the effects of immunotherapy via a blockade of PD-1 with the anti-angiogenesis effects associated with blocking VEGF into a single molecule. By design, ivonescimab displays unique cooperative binding to each of its intended targets with multifold higher affinity to PD-1 when in the presence of VEGF. This design is intended to differentiate ivonescimab as there is potentially higher expression (presence) of both PD-1 and VEGF in tumor tissue and the tumor microenvironment (TME) as compared to normal tissue in the body. Summit believes ivonescimab's specifically engineered tetravalent structure (four binding sites) enables higher avidity (accumulated strength of multiple binding interactions) in the TME (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025). This tetravalent structure, the intentional novel design of the molecule, and bringing these two targets into a single bispecific antibody with cooperative binding qualities have the potential to direct ivonescimab to the tumor tissue versus healthy tissue. The intent of ivonescimab's design, together with a half-life of 6 to 7 days after the first dose (Zhong, et al, iScience, 2025) increasing to approximately 10 days at steady state dosing, is to improve upon previously established efficacy thresholds, side effects, and safety profiles associated with prior approved drugs to these targets. Ivonescimab was invented by Akeso Inc. (HKEX Code: 9926.HK) and is currently utilized in multiple Phase III clinical trials. Over 5,000 patients have been treated with ivonescimab in clinical studies globally and over 100,000 patients when considering those treated in a commercial setting in China, as noted by Akeso. There are currently 17 Phase III clinical studies that are either announced, ongoing, or have been completed studying ivonescimab, five of which are Summit-sponsored global studies, two of which are studies sponsored by cooperative groups, and 10 of which are being or have been conducted in China by Akeso. Summit began its clinical development of ivonescimab in NSCLC (HARMONi, HARMONi-3, HARMONi-7) and expanded its sponsored Phase III clinical development program into colorectal cancer (CRC; HARMONi-GI3) and urothelial carcinoma (bladder cancer; HARMONi-GU1). The two cooperative studies are in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC; ILLUMINE) and biliary tract cancer (BTC; EA2251). Five Phase III ivonescimab clinical trials have read out to date, all five with positive data. Four of these five studies are in NSCLC and one is in BTC. In addition to Summit's positive HARMONi study in NSCLC, Akeso has had positive read-outs in four single-region (China), randomized Phase III clinical trials, HARMONi-A, HARMONi-2, HARMONi-6 (each in NSCLC), and HARMONi-GI1 (in BTC) for ivonescimab, including a statistically significant overall survival benefit in all four studies from China. Akeso is actively conducting additional Phase III clinical studies in settings outside of NSCLC and biliary-tract cancer, including triple-negative breast cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, and pancreatic cancer. Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy that is not approved by any regulatory authority in Summit's license territories, including the United States and Europe. Ivonescimab was initially approved for marketing authorization in China in May 2024. About Lunit Founded in 2013, Lunit (KRX: 328130) is a global leader on a mission to conquer cancer through AI. Our clinically validated solutions span medical imaging, breast health, and biomarker analysis, empowering earlier detection, smarter treatment decisions, and more precise outcomes across the cancer care continuum. Lunit offers a comprehensive suite spanning risk prediction and early detection to precision oncology. Our FDA-cleared Lunit INSIGHT Breast Suite and breast health solutions support cancer screening in thousands of medical institutions worldwide, while the Lunit SCOPE platform is used in research partnership with global pharma and laboratory leaders for biomarker research, and companion diagnostic development. Trusted by over 10,000 sites in more than 65 countries, Lunit combines deep medical expertise with continuously evolving datasets to deliver measurable impact for patients, clinicians, and researchers alike. Headquartered in Seoul with global offices, Lunit is driving the worldwide fight against cancer. Learn more at lunit.io. About Summit Therapeutics Inc. Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient-, physician-, caregiver- and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs. Summit was founded in 2003 and the company's shares are listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (symbol "SMMT"). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, with additional offices in Palo Alto, California, Princeton, New Jersey, Dublin, Ireland, and Oxford, UK. For more information, please visit https://www.smmttx.com and follow Summit on X @SMMT_TX. ae.title: Abu Dhabi launches Emiratisation policy for private schools: 2,000 Emirati teachers targeted over five years
ae.description: Abu Dhabi: In a move aimed at increasing the presence of Emirati talent in classrooms, the Abu Dhabi Department of Education and Knowledge (ADEK) launched an Emiratisation policy for the private education sector. The policy aims to attract more than 2,000 Emirati teachers over the next five years through an integrated system combining training, professional development, financial support, and direct employment opportunities. The policy is distinguished by linking Emiratisation targets to schools' needs and employment commitments, and by providing clear career paths for Emirati citizens, in cooperation with the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) and the UAE Competitiveness Council and its strategic national Nafis programme, which boosts the participation of UAE nationals in the private sector. In detail, ADEK launched the Emiratisation policy in the private education sector, in cooperation with MOHRE, and the UAE Competitiveness Council’s Nafis programme, in partnership with a number of private educational institutions, with the aim of expanding opportunities to attract and qualify national talents to work in the teaching profession in private schools in Abu Dhabi. This step combines regulatory policies, national talent development programmes, support for career paths, and educational institutions’ employment commitments, within an integrated approach that provides Emirati citizens with clear pathways for training, qualification, and employment in the private education sector. These efforts also aim to bring more than 2,000 citizens into the teaching staff over the next five years. ADEK affirmed that the Emiratisation policy in the private education sector provides schools with the necessary tools and pathways to achieve it, including access to qualified national talents who have undergone screening and evaluation processes. It noted that the policy is based on the Abu Dhabi Educators Competency Framework, which ADEK developed in cooperation with the Emirates College for Educational Development, and is based on six sets of values and competencies, including Emirati national identity and respect for cultures, integrity and moral responsibility, humility, respect, empathy and community spirit, excellence and intellectual curiosity, lifelong learning, flexibility and innovation, in addition to cooperation and collective responsibility. ADEK announced the signing of strategic agreements to transform policy targets into practical opportunities, linking localisation targets with clear commitments from educational institutions to train, qualify, and employ national talent in their schools. The agreements included the employment of more than 200 Emirati teachers at Taaleem, more than 150 at SABIS, more than 120 at GEMS Education, more than 77 at International Community Schools, and more than 61 at Liwa Education, thus providing hundreds of new job opportunities for Emirati citizens. It noted that the recruitment and employment efforts in the first phase will focus on the specialisations of social studies, Arabic language, and Islamic education, with the aim of attracting and gradually integrating national talent into schools over the next five years. ADEK confirmed its collaboration with MOHRE and the UAE Competitiveness Council to attract and develop Emirati citizens through a range of specialised initiatives and programmes. Qualified candidates can enrol in one of the available training programmes, including the Medad programme, which provides citizens with an introductory opportunity to learn about the teaching profession and explore its career paths. It also includes the ‘Be a Teacher’ programme, which offers promising talents the opportunity to obtain a postgraduate qualification in education. It pointed to the launch and activation of the Teachers programme, one of the main initiatives of the Nafis strategy, to build a sustainable base of qualified Emirati teachers, by removing obstacles to joining the teaching profession, and linking national competencies with training and employment opportunities in private schools, noting that the programme includes two main tracks, namely the Teacher and the Assistant Teacher, and participants who meet the eligibility conditions within the Teacher track can receive a monthly financial incentive of up to Dh4,000 throughout the training period.

ae.title: UAE doctors: Men are avoiding mental health treatment, and these 10 reasons explain why
ae.description: Abu Dhabi: Psychologists have reported that social norms force men to feel ashamed or embarrassed if they lose their ability to compose themselves in the face of situations they encounter. They said it is common for men to be less emotional than women, and this means – in the opinion of the majority – that they should not show any signs of weakness, no matter how harsh or complicated the circumstance or situation they face, noting that “these beliefs can cause great psychological stress.” Doctors identified the main reasons why some men hesitate to seek support or consult a psychiatrist, including: A stereotypical image of masculinity and its conflict with showing sadness, fear, or weakness. Avoiding the societal view that makes him appear weak or incapable of taking responsibility. Difficulty expressing feelings due to not being accustomed to it since childhood. The belief of many that they can overcome psychological problems on their own, without help. Confusing psychological strength with suppressing feelings, thinking that it is evidence of toughness. Not recognising psychological symptoms. Fear of the impact of psychological treatment on the social and professional image. Preoccupation with responsibilities and financial pressures. Weak awareness of the usefulness of psychological treatment. Postponing attention to mental health and replacing it with immersion in work or isolation, or the use of harmful substances. Psychological balance Dr. Medhat Al-Sabahi, a consultant psychiatrist, stressed that paying attention to mental health is not a sign of weakness, but rather an essential step to promote psychological balance and improve the quality of life and general health of men, especially since psychological problems can negatively affect daily habits that contribute to promoting physical health, such as sleep, nutrition and exercise. He said that neglecting mental health not only affects emotional stability, but also contributes to the exacerbation of many health and physical problems, and may negatively affect an individual's professional performance and productivity, and lead to economic losses as a result of wasted working hours and a decline in the quality of achievement. He explained that stress, anxiety, and depression affect concentration and the ability to make sound decisions, slow down the completion of tasks, and may increase rates of absenteeism or attendance with a weak ability to perform, which increases the likelihood of errors. Moreover, the accumulation of professional pressures and the lack of sufficient support may lead to psychological burnout, loss of passion for work, and a decline in the quality of communication with colleagues and teamwork, in addition to physical symptoms such as headaches, sleep disorders, and fatigue that deplete the employee's daily energy. He pointed out that the most prominent psychological disorders that men may suffer from include depression, anxiety disorders, alcohol and drug use disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder, sleep disorders related to psychological problems, bipolar disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, personality disorders, schizophrenia and psychotic disorders, in addition to eating disorders. He warned that ignoring symptoms or delaying seeking specialised medical help could worsen the condition and increase its impact on the patient's life, family, and community. Misconceptions Dr. Amir Javed, a consultant psychiatrist at Burjeel Medical City, confirmed that some social beliefs still link masculinity to toughness and the ability to withstand pressures without being affected, which reinforces the belief that men are less prone to psychological disorders. However, mental health is not related to gender or age, as a person may face circumstances and pressures at different stages of his life that affect his psychological balance and require care and attention. He pointed out that the factors affecting mental health are not limited to social and emotional conditions, but also include physical causes, such as hormonal disorders, and a deficiency of some vitamins and nutrients, including vitamin D, and hypothyroidism, which requires a medical evaluation to determine the causes and choose the appropriate treatment, whether by compensating for the nutritional deficiency or using medications when needed. He stressed the importance of promoting awareness of mental health from childhood, by helping children and adolescents understand their feelings and express them freely without ridicule or belittling them. This places a fundamental role on parents in supporting the psychological and social development of their children, as ignoring their feelings or demanding that they hide them may lead to low self-esteem, fear of others, a tendency towards isolation, and difficulty in building social relationships. He called for a review of some inherited phrases, such as “a man doesn’t cry” and “be a man,” which are used to prevent a child from expressing his sadness or weakness, explaining that crying is a natural human response that does not diminish a person’s strength, and that proper upbringing is based on teaching children to understand their feelings and deal with them instead of suppressing them, which enhances their psychological balance and their ability to communicate and ask for help when needed. Therapeutic concerns Psychiatric consultant Dr. Nawfal Iyad stressed the importance of highlighting men's mental health, noting that psychological disorders can affect anyone and negatively impact their health and quality of life, especially since the pressures associated with the idea of the ‘ideal man’ drive many men to strive to appear strong and dominant, which may lead to tension, anxiety, and other psychological disorders. He pointed out that some men's fears of the potential side effects of certain medications, particularly their impact on fertility, can be addressed by using appropriate treatment alternatives, and some cases do not require the use of medications as part of the treatment plan. He warned that the social stigma associated with mental health may lead sufferers to hide their suffering or delay treatment for fear of being judged or discriminated against, which may exacerbate psychological disorders and social isolation, reduce quality of life, lower self-esteem, and weaken performance. He pointed out the importance of making the patient aware that he is not alone in this experience, encouraging him to seek medical help and trust in the effectiveness of treatment, in addition to providing family support, active participation in the treatment plan, maintaining activity and social communication, and avoiding isolation. Family support Social and psychological specialists Ahmed Abdel Salam, Nadine Mansour, and Sarah Al-Khatib stated that families' concern for their children's health should not be limited to monitoring physical symptoms. They noted that some parents overlook a student's psychological state as long as they are not complaining of pain or fatigue, despite changes in behaviour, a decline in academic performance, sleep disturbances, a tendency towards isolation, and a loss of interest in previously enjoyed activities. These specialists emphasised that such signs warrant attention and follow-up. They stressed that observing these changes early and addressing them consciously contributes to understanding the child's needs and providing appropriate support before the problem worsens. They pointed to the importance of building daily communication based on trust and dialogue between parents and their children, by dedicating time to listening to them and encouraging them to express their feelings and fears without blame or belittling their experiences. They also emphasised the importance of strengthening cooperation between the family and the school and seeking help from a psychologist or social worker when psychological difficulties are detected. They noted that comprehensive care begins with paying attention to what the child is feeling, not just to their physical symptoms. What he is complaining about physically. 143 facilities for mental health The Department of Health - Abu Dhabi confirmed its continued development of an integrated mental health system, moving from responding when needed to proactively providing ongoing support to individuals, thereby enhancing their quality of life and addressing their needs before challenges escalate. It also confirmed an 81% increase in the number of mental health professionals since 2022. It added that it had drawn up plans to double the patient capacity over the next two years, ensuring the provision of specialised services that meet the growing needs of the community. The department said that it has integrated mental health services within primary care centres, by training more than 1,930 family doctors to diagnose and manage common mental conditions, such as anxiety and depression, which allows individuals to get support from the nearest point to them, with the possibility of referring them to a specialist when needed. It pointed out that the emirate currently has 143 mental health facilities, including 13 specialised centres, in which 640 qualified specialists work, within an integrated system that ensures the continuity of care, and directs cases to the most appropriate level according to their needs, which enhances the efficiency of service delivery, and improves its outcomes. Dedicated hotline The Department of Health - Abu Dhabi has activated the 800-Sakina hotline to provide psychological support services at any time, in a step that is consistent with its commitment to protecting the health of community members and promoting their psychological well-being. The hotline provides primary mental health care services, along with direct access to qualified mental health professionals for immediate support when needed. The Department also made available a mental health self-assessment tool through the TAMM platform for adults aged 18 and above, enabling them to better understand their mental health, receive personalised recommendations, and seek specialised support and advice when required. The Department's Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre launched several initiatives to raise community awareness and change attitudes towards mental health, most notably the interactive ‘Beauty of Our Minds’ experience, which provided platforms for community dialogue, helped break down the stigma associated with seeking support, and promoted the understanding of mental health as a natural part of human life.

sa.title: «ديلي تلغراف» البريطانية تعتزم تسريح نحو 100 موظف والاعتماد على الذكاء الاصطناعي
sa.description: تعتزم مجموعة «ديلي تلغراف» الإعلامية البريطانية الاستغناء عن نحو 100 موظف، ضمن خطة لإعادة هيكلة المؤسسة وتحويلها إلى شركة إعلامية عالمية تعتمد بصورة أكبر على الذكاء الاصطناعي والتقنيات الرقمية، بعد أشهر من استحواذ مجموعة «أكسل شبرينغر» الألمانية عليها.وذكرت صحيفة «الغارديان» البريطانية أن الإدارة الجديدة أبلغت الموظفين، أمس (الجمعة)، ببدء تنفيذ تغييرات تنظيمية واسعة، تشمل تقليص الوظائف وإعادة ترتيب الأقسام التحريرية، في إطار إستراتيجيةً تستهدف تطوير أعمال المؤسسة وتنويع مصادر إيراداتها.تقليص الوظائف وإعادة الهيكلةوبحسب التقرير، تلقى عدد من الموظفين إشعارات بالاستغناء عن خدماتهم، فيما بدأت المؤسسة إجراءات التشاور الرسمية بشأن تخفيض الوظائف، دون إعلانِ حصيلةٍ نهائيةٍ لعدد العاملين المتأثرين، وسط توقعاتٍ بأن يصل العدد إلى نحو 100 موظف.وأوضحت الرئيسة التنفيذية للمجموعة، كارولين هولشوف بول، في رسالة داخلية للموظفين، أن المؤسسة تسعى إلى التحول من صحيفةٍ بريطانيةٍ تقليديةٍ إلى شركةٍ عالميةٍ للإعلام والمعلومات المتخصصةِ، مدعومةً بالذكاء الاصطناعي والبيانات والتكنولوجيا الحديثة.وأضافت أن التحول المرتقب يتطلب إعادة تنظيم العمل، وتسريع اتخاذ القرارات، وتبسيط الهيكل الإداري، ورفع الكفاءة التشغيلية، مؤكدةً أن المؤسسة ستوسع استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي مع المحافظة على العناصر التي لا تستطيع التكنولوجيا استبدالها، وفي مقدمتها الحكم التحريري والأصالة والثقة.التوسع في المنتجات الرقمية والأسواق الدوليةوتتضمن الخطة تطوير مصادر دخل جديدة عبر إنتاج الفيديو والمحتوى الصوتي، وتنظيم الفعاليات، وتقديم خدمات للشركات، إلى جانب التراخيص التجارية والمنتجات الرقمية، مع التوسع في الأسواق الدولية، خصوصاً في مجالات الشؤون الخارجية والدفاع والأعمال.استحواذ ألماني بقيمة 575 مليون جنيه إسترلينيوتأتي هذه الخطوات بعد استحواذ مجموعة «أكسل شبرينغر» الألمانية على «ديلي تلغراف» في يونيو الماضي مقابل 575 مليون جنيه إسترليني، منهيةً نحو ثلاث سنواتٍ من عدم اليقين بشأن ملكية الصحيفة البريطانية.وكانت المجموعة الألمانية، التي تمتلك أيضاً مؤسساتٍ إعلاميةً من بينها «بوليتيكو» و«بيزنس إنسايدر» وصحيفتا «بيلد» و«دي فيلت»، قد تعهدت عند إتمام الصفقة بالاستثمار في تطوير «ديلي تلغراف» وتوسيع حضورها الدولي.مخاوف بشأن مستقبل الوظائف الصحفيةوأثارت خطة تقليص الوظائف تساؤلاتٍ داخل المؤسسة بشأن تأثير إعادة الهيكلة في العمل الصحفي، خصوصاً مع اتجاه الإدارة إلى زيادة الاعتماد على التقنيات الحديثة بالتزامن مع تخفيض عدد العاملين.

sa.title: النفط يقفز أكثر من 3 دولارات مسجلًا أعلى مستوى في 6 أشهر
sa.description: ارتفعت أسعار النفط اليوم، بأكثر من ثلاثة دولارات عند التسوية، مسجلة أعلى مستوى لها منذ ما يقرب من ستة أشهر، متأثرة بمخاوف من حدوث مزيد من الاضطرابات في إمدادات الطاقة من الشرق الأوسط. وصعدت العقود الآجلة لخام برنت 3.55 دولارات، أي 3.14%، لتصل إلى 116.72 دولارًا للبرميل عند التسوية، وهو أعلى مستوى لها منذ 29 أبريل. أسعار النفط وزادت العقود الآجلة لخام غرب تكساس الوسيط الأمريكي 3.80 دولارات أو 3.8% إلى 103.27 دولارات. وأنهى خام برنت الأسبوع مرتفعًا 6%، بينما اختتم خام غرب تكساس الوسيط الأمريكي الأسبوع بارتفاع 2.3%.

sa.title: تحليل جيني يكشف ارتباطاً بين فايروس إيبولا في نيجيريا وأول إصابة في كينيا
sa.description: كشفت السلطات الصحية النيجيرية عن وجود تشابه جيني وثيق بين فايروس الإيبولا المكتشف لدى أول مصابة في البلاد، والفايروس الذي تسبب في أول إصابة مسجلة في كينيا، في تطور قد يساعد على تحديد مسارات انتقال العدوى بين الدول الأفريقية التي تشهد تفشياً للمرض.وأعلن وزير الصحة والرعاية الاجتماعية النيجيري محمد علي باتي، أمس (الجمعة)، أن نتائج التحليل الجيني أظهرت تقارباً كبيراً بين العينتين، ما يمثل أول دليلاً جينياً على وجود صلة بين الفايروسين المكتشفين في البلدين.وأوضح أن هذا التشابه لا يثبت انتقال العدوى مباشرةً بين المصابين، مؤكداً عدم وجود أدلة على سفر المصاب الأول في كينيا إلى نيجيريا أو حدوث اتصال مباشر بين الحالتين، فيما تتواصل التحقيقات الوبائية لتحديد مصدر الإصابة ومسار انتقال الفايروس.وكانت نيجيريا قد أعلنت في 20 أكتوبر تسجيل إصابة مؤكدة بفايروس الإيبولا من سلالة «بونديبوغيو» في العاصمة أبوجا، لدى امرأة عادت من أوغندا، وظهرت عليها الأعراض في السابع من أكتوبر، قبل تأكيد إصابتها مخبرياً.وأشار الوزير إلى أن السلطات الصحية تواصل تتبع المخالطين وإخضاعهم للمراقبة والفحوص الطبية، موضحاً أن بعض نتائج الاختبارات جاءت سلبية، فيما لا تزال نتائج أخرى قيد الانتظار، دون تسجيل إصابات مؤكدة إضافيةً في نيجيريا حتى وقت الإعلان.وفي سياق التحقيقات، كشفت المراكز الأفريقية لمكافحة الأمراض والوقاية منها أن المصابين الأولين في نيجيريا وكينيا عبرا مطار عنتيبي الدولي في أوغندا في الثالث من أكتوبر، ما دفع الجهات الصحية إلى دراسة احتمال وجود ارتباط بين رحلتيهما، دون التوصل حتى الآن إلى دليلاً يثبت انتقال العدوى بينهما.وفي كينيا، أعلنت وزارة الصحة، أمس (الجمعة)، تسجيل وفاةً ثانيةً بالمرض لامرأة تبلغ 65 عاماً، كانت من المخالطين للمصاب الأول، فيما يواصل سبعة مرضى تلقي العلاج داخل مرافق العزل الصحي.وتأتي هذه التطورات في ظل استمرار تفشي سلالة «بونديبوغيو» في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية، حيث أكدت منظمة الصحة العالمية تسجيل 9704 إصابات و4687 وفاة حتى 20 أكتوبر الجاري.وتؤكد الجهات الصحية أهمية التحليل الجيني في تتبع انتشار الفايروس، إلى جانب مراقبة المخالطين وتعزيز إجراءات الوقاية والكشف المبكر، للحد من انتقال العدوى عبر الحدود.

iq.title: مخاطر اقتصادية تهدد العالم.. وهذه انعكاساتها على العراق
iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد حذر الخبير المصرفي المصري والمتخصص في إدارة المخاطر الائتمانية، طارق إسماعيل، يوم الجمعة، من اتساع التداعيات الاقتصادية للصراعات الدولية، وما تفرضه من اضطرابات على سلاسل الإمداد وأسواق الطاقة والاستثمارات، مشيراً إلى أن اعتماد العراق الكبير على النفط يجعله عرضة لتقلبات الأسواق العالمية، في ظل اتساع الفجوة بين إيرادات الدولة ونفقاتها. وقال إسماعيل لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن استمرار الصراعات والتوترات الجيوسياسية لا يعني بالضرورة أن مستقبل الاقتصاد العالمي يتجه نحو مزيد من التشاؤم، موضحاً أن التحدي الأساسي يكمن في قدرة الدول على إدارة الأزمات والحد من تداعياتها، ولا سيما في الاقتصادات الأكثر ارتباطاً بتقلبات الأسواق الخارجية. وأوضح أن اضطراب سلاسل الإمداد وحالة عدم اليقين يمثلان اثنين من أبرز التحديات التي تواجه الاقتصاد العالمي، إذ تؤدي النزاعات إلى تعطيل حركة التجارة وارتفاع تكاليف النقل والإنتاج، فيما تجعل التقلبات غير المتوقعة قرارات الاستثمار والتعاقد والتخطيط الاقتصادي أكثر تعقيداً. وأشار إلى أن أسواق النفط تقدم مثالاً واضحاً على هذه المخاطر، إذ قد تدفع التوترات بعض الدول إلى إبرام عقود بأسعار مرتفعة تحسباً لاستمرار التصعيد، لكنها قد تجد نفسها أمام التزامات مالية مكلفة إذا انتهت الأزمة وتراجعت الأسعار. وعن الاقتصاد العراقي، بيّن إسماعيل أن الاعتماد الواسع على النفط في تمويل الموازنة العامة يجعل البلاد أكثر عرضة للصدمات الخارجية، سواء الناجمة عن تقلب الأسعار أو اضطراب الإمدادات وحركة التجارة، الأمر الذي يستدعي إعادة النظر في بنية الاقتصاد ومصادر إيراداته. وتأتي هذه التحذيرات في وقت أظهرت فيه أحدث بيانات وزارة المالية العراقية اتساع الفجوة بين الإيرادات والنفقات إلى نحو 30.432 تريليون دينار خلال الأشهر الثمانية الأولى من عام 2026، بعدما بلغت الإيرادات 45.355 تريليون دينار، مقابل مصروفات بنحو 75.787 تريليون دينار. وبحسب البيانات، التي تحصلت عليها وكالة شفق نيوز في 21 تشرين الأول/ أكتوبر الجاري، شكلت الإيرادات النفطية نحو 77% من إجمالي موارد الدولة، ما يعكس استمرار اعتماد المالية العامة على قطاع واحد شديد التأثر بالتطورات الإقليمية والدولية. كما كشفت بيانات رسمية سابقة تراجع الإيرادات النفطية العراقية بنسبة 53% خلال الأشهر السبعة الأولى من العام الحالي، مقارنة بالفترة ذاتها من عام 2025، بالتزامن مع اضطرابات شهدتها حركة تصدير النفط عبر مضيق هرمز نتيجة الحرب في المنطقة. وفي هذا السياق، شدد إسماعيل على ضرورة وضع خطة اقتصادية طويلة الأمد لتنويع مصادر الدخل، وتقليل الاعتماد على العائدات النفطية، بالتوازي مع تحسين بيئة الأعمال وتوفير الضمانات والتسهيلات اللازمة لجذب المستثمرين المحليين والأجانب. ورأى أن توسيع دور القطاع الخاص من شأنه توفير فرص عمل جديدة وتخفيف الضغط عن الإنفاق الحكومي، خصوصاً في ظل التحديات التي تواجه الموازنة العراقية وتزايد الحاجة إلى تنمية القطاعات الإنتاجية غير النفطية. ودعا الخبير المصري إلى الاستثمار في تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي وقواعد البيانات والبنية التحتية الرقمية، إلى جانب دعم المشروعات الصغيرة والمتوسطة وتطوير التعليم الفني والتقني بما ينسجم مع التحولات المرتقبة في سوق العمل. كما أكد أهمية تعزيز التكامل الاقتصادي العربي وتوجيه المزيد من الاستثمارات إلى داخل المنطقة، بما يسهم في بناء اقتصادات أكثر قدرة على مواجهة الاضطرابات العالمية. وكان وزير المالية العراقي، فالح ساري، قد أعلن في 14 تشرين الأول/ أكتوبر الجاري أن "رؤية العراق 2050" تستهدف تقليل الاعتماد على النفط وتمكين القطاع الخاص وتعزيز النمو المستدام، في إطار مساعٍ حكومية لتنويع النشاط الاقتصادي. وخلص إسماعيل إلى أن بناء اقتصاد عراقي أكثر مرونة يتطلب انتقالاً تدريجياً من نموذج يعتمد بصورة أساسية على الإنفاق العام والإيرادات النفطية إلى اقتصاد متنوع وأكثر إنتاجية، قادر على خلق فرص أوسع للشباب والحد من تأثير الصراعات والتقلبات الخارجية.
